tur34-0: Do the holds without straining. If you feel dizzy or short of breath, switch to the Calm pace or return to your normal breathing. If you have serious heart or lung disease, ask your doctor before using techniques with breath holds.
tur34-1: For box breathing, breathe in for 4 seconds, hold for 4, breathe out for 4 and hold for 4. For the 4-7-8 technique, breathe in through your nose for 4 seconds, hold for 7, then breathe out through slightly parted lips over 8 seconds. Do the holds without straining; if you have serious heart or lung disease, ask your doctor before using techniques with breath holds.
